method: for every rule set: decode the locked NSO (size, SHA256, build ID, per-segment hashes), re-read each site word and compare it with the recorded original bytes, place one island per site in the module-local island region, compile the entry and return branches and round-trip them
limits: Planning only. No module is loaded at the planned base, no site word is written, the island payload still misses the deferred host directory fixup, and the udiv rule set stays blocked until its site preconditions are proven. Nothing here proves permissions, cache, fault or game behaviour.
